stages.title: AI-native plan editing - prompt to diff to confirm to apply
stages.notes: Deliver G1 per docs/history/CONDUCTOR-AI-NATIVE.md (G1) + CONDUCTOR-AI-NATIVE.md rows G1.1/G1.2. REUSE, do not fork: PlanImportService.ImportAsync (prose->advisor->plan), PlanDiff.Compute/Apply, and the Face import-diff view (plan.go renderImportDiff). G1.1: teach POST /plan/import (or a sibling /plan/prompt) to route freeform prose through the advisor(Fable) model instead of 400-ing, returning the same diff/confirm/apply contract; contract tests. G1.2: a Plan-tab Prompt box that posts the prompt and renders the returned PlanDiffDto with the existing view, a=apply/esc=cancel; goldens + a unit test driving the keys. Gate: curl {"source":"add a lint gate that runs dotnet format","apply":false} returns a diff with the gate; apply:true persists + bumps planVersion; invalid result rejected without writing.

stages.title: Kanban board - live task graph with move/add actions
stages.notes: Deliver G2 per docs/history/CONDUCTOR-AI-NATIVE.md (G2) + rows G2.1/G2.2. REUSE: GET /tasks + TaskDto + TaskGraph; the MCP task_update/task_add write semantics (McpTaskServer.Handlers) - factor the shared write so HTTP and MCP can't drift. G2.1: POST /tasks/update {taskId,status} + POST /tasks/add {checkpointId,title,order} emitting TaskStatusChanged/TaskAdded; contract tests. G2.2: a Kanban tab (11th tab, mnemonic b for board; reachable by b + tab-cycle - there is NO spare digit past 0, do not imply one) with columns TODO/In-Progress/Done from GET /tasks, up/down select, left/right move a card across columns (POST /tasks/update), n add under the selected checkpoint (POST /tasks/add), re-fetch after a write; demo-source mirror + goldens at 80x24/120x30/200x50. Gate: POST /tasks/add then GET /tasks shows the card in TODO; update to done moves it; a Face golden shows three populated columns.

stages.title: Live and dynamic - author-before-run, live plan reload, live limits
stages.notes: Deliver G3 per docs/history/CONDUCTOR-AI-NATIVE.md (G3) + rows G3.1/G3.2/G3.3. Closes the last live gaps. REUSE, do not fork: the Paused idle path already in RunLoop.cs (~L87), RunOptions (Orchestrator.cs), ControlFile.Parse (single-sources the POST /control whitelist), ControlDispatcher, LoadPlanFresh + ApplyPlanEdit (ControlPlaneServer.Plan.cs), the Plan-tab Settings section. G3.1: add --paused to RunCommand/RunOptions -> state.Status=Paused before the loop; dashboard+control plane up, engine idle, zero sessions until resume; unit test flag->status. G3.2: new ControlAction.ReloadPlan mapped in ControlFile.Parse + dispatched in ControlDispatcher; at the NEXT SESSION BOUNDARY ONLY (never mid-session), re-read the plan (PlanConfig.Load / LoadPlanFresh) and swap the live RunContext.Plan; /plan/edit + applied /plan/import auto-enqueue ReloadPlan; update PlanReloadCommand wording; contract test edits-then-reads-live-plan + defer-under-running-agent. G3.3: extend Plan-tab Settings + ApplyPlanEdit to edit limits (maxRunCostUsd/maxRunTokens/stallMinutes/sessionTimeoutMinutes) + a live session cap; loop honours them at the boundary (cap-down parks to Paused, never crash; cap-up continues); Face golden + key-driving test + contract test. Gate: run --paused shows Paused with 0 sessions then resume starts s1; a live stage edit is honoured by the next session after reload; maxSessions lowered below current count parks the run. The swap point is the session boundary and ONLY there.
